reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at PC Chandra Jewellers. The showroom had a wide range of elegant and beautifully crafted jewellery pieces. A special mention to Gyaneshwari Ji, who assisted us with great patience and professionalism. She guided us through the collection, understood our preferences, and helped us make the right choice. Her warm and courteous approach truly enhanced our shopping experience. We are very happy with our purchase and highly recommend visiting this store.

This is my first time purchase from jamshedpur store, though we r very old customer of p.c Chandra,( Kolkata) Most trustworthy store, they treated their customers very well, humble behavior , welcoming faces,specialy my dealing staff was great,It was very nice to visit p.c chandra,jsr..

Very helpful staff especially Pritam Nandi. He guided us really well and also offered us best deals. The gold designs were good and caters to every customers requirements. Very good purchasing experience.

I bought my engagement ring.
And the experience was very smooth, I met Laxmi and she is very professional.

I would like to give her 5 out 5.
Thanks.
Really today enjoyed my Birthday celebration. I am thankful to the staff here to give me such an honour. I was invited by Madam Laxmi on behalf of P. C. Chandra, Jamshedpur.

We visited the showroom today. It was a great experience. Madam Piu, Subhadra helped us during the process. They are extremely customer oriented.
